dossier.summary: Cedar Valley Dental Group runs eleven family dental offices across two counties. A central billing team handles insurance for every office.
dossier.why_now: Added three offices in the last year.

reasons.team: We assumed about 1 in 9 of the 51 to 200 people handle claims, a common split for a group that bills for many offices from one place.
reasons.hours: Checking claim status, resubmitting denials and posting payments. We assumed 11 hours a week each.
reasons.rate: Pay for a billing specialist plus benefits and overhead, in US dollars. Change it if your blended cost is different.
reasons.tools: A billing system add-on, a clearinghouse plan and shared spreadsheets. You will know the actual figure.
